label: Present-tense reception entails onset reception
meaning: Strength order registration: the present-tense reading of reception entails the onset reading, since a first moment of presence (BeginsAt) is a moment at which the thing is present. A single application of the premise (invariant 16), registered for the strength order, not as progress; it establishes neither. Strict: Control part 1 (receipt at the first moment only).
